meta.project: DeelRx Inventory and Credit Management Platform

product_overview: DeelRx is a unified, multi-tenant retail platform designed for regulated inventory-driven businesses. It provides a privacy-first, high-performance POS system with granular owner-configurable controls for inventory, credit management, and compliance.
core_goals: Deliver a blazing-fast, accurate, and privacy-centric POS system compatible with mobile and web.
Enable full business control with detailed inventory tracking, credit management, and owner-customizable settings.
Ensure stringent tenant data isolation and compliance with privacy and audit requirements.
Support multi-unit measurement handling with automatic conversions and alias management.
Provide an intuitive onboarding process capturing all critical business setup data.
Implement end-to-end encryption, strict role-based permissions, and comprehensive audit logs for security and compliance.
key_features: Multi-tenant architecture with strict data isolation and scoped user roles.
Guided onboarding capturing business details, privacy presets, unit settings, and initial roles.
Comprehensive inventory management supporting intake, adjustments, batch imports, and audit logging.
Flexible unit and alias management including cross-unit conversions and quickpick quantities.
Credit Management API enabling credit limit refreshes, exposure reporting, and transaction oversight.
POS and transaction workflows optimized for speed and privacy with barcode and offline mode options.
Advanced privacy controls with presets ranging from open CRM to max secure alias-only modes including failsafes and data burn actions.
Audit log retention and GDPR compliance including irreversible deletion of PII where applicable.
Owner-configurable settings for credit policies, loyalty programs, compliance retention, and export permissions.
user_flow_summary: Tenant onboarding flow capturing all required business information, privacy presets, unit selections, and initial user roles first before usage.
Inventory intake process with product selection via text search or barcode scan, quantity input in multiple units, reason selection, and audit logging.
Inventory adjustment workflow supporting increments, decrements, or absolute quantity setting with mandatory reason and permission checks.
Batch upload and multi-row intake for inventory via CSV with full audit logging and error handling.
POS sales and transaction processing with alias auto-fill, offline support, and privacy mode enforcement.
Admin management of settings post-onboarding including reasons lists, credit policies, role management, and privacy configurations.
Audit log review and compliance reporting available to authorized roles, respecting tenant and privacy boundaries.
validation_criteria: Complete tenant data isolation verified with no cross-tenant access or data leaks.
Mandatory completion of all required onboarding fields before tenant activation.
All inventory transactions logged with user, timestamp, previous and new quantities, reason, and device source within 30 seconds.
Role-based access strictly enforced to limit actions and data visibility.
Privacy presets functional with audit logs, export restrictions, and irrevocable data burn options operating as intended.
Performance benchmarks met: sub-1 second response for POS operations and under 2 seconds for batch imports.
Security features including multi-factor authentication, end-to-end encryption, and tamper-proof audit logs implemented.
Offline operations sync correctly and deduplicate changes without data loss or corruption.
Compliance features including GDPR “right to be forgotten” and retention policies validated through testing.
